data.one_liner: Dart model classes for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with zero dependencies.
data.what_it_does: Provides plain Dart model classes for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) schema, covering tools, resources, prompts, subscriptions, and notifications. Includes serialization and deserialization methods (toMap and named factories) without requiring code generation, along with a McpBuilder helper.
use_when: Building Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients or servers in Dart
Working with MCP messages, tools, resources, and prompts without code generation
avoid_when: You do not need to interact with the Model Context Protocol
strengths: Full coverage of the MCP 2026-07-28 schema
Zero runtime dependencies and pure Dart
McpBuilder helper for declarative server capability registration
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the evolving Model Context Protocol specification
